reader_summary.overview: Colin Campbell is a Partner at Bain Capital and co-head of the Partnership Strategies team that manages assets primarily for Bain Capital's partners in strategies that diversify away from the equity-orientation of the firm's core.. In its search for attractive, uncorrelated assets, the Partnership Strategies team became an early mover in environmental markets.

key_points.text: Colin Campbell is a Partner at Bain Capital and co-head of the Partnership Strategies team that manages assets primarily for Bain Capital's partners in strategies that diversify away from the equity-orientation of the firm's core..
Both Tom Steyer and Bill Orum cited carbon credits and offsets as a necessary and important near-term component to effect climate transition.
Colin's deep engagement in the space provides a wonderful primer for those interested.
